title: P15.9-B5.2: /app/system/business-admin + /app/workforce/admin legacy admin parity
description: Legacy Business-tab parity on canonical APIs only (zero backend changes). /app/system/business-admin: create business (project_id verified via GET /api/projects, fail-closed when unavailable), inspect-by-id rendering biz.detail() bundle, global list labeled unfiltered. /app/workforce/admin bound to selected business: create org-agent (auto-contract), create work-item (never auto-opened), open/block/unblock/comment via pinned dialogs (open = HIGH-IMPACT), routine create+enable/disable, legacy objective labeled LEGACY compat. Dialogs pin {op,biz,target,payload}, invalidate on business change, dup-submit guarded, ambiguous wording on transport/5xx, same-business-only selects (backend FAIL_CLOSED_*_SCOPE authoritative). E2E workforce-admin.spec.ts covers the 19-item list. R1: SPA business switch wipes all business-dependent forms + submit() revalidates reports_to/assignee/objective_id; inspect clears stale detail + verifies returned id; sect() validates envelopes. R2: rowsOk() element-level validation on all collection boundaries — arrays with null/primitive/identity-less rows → MALFORMED, never silently filtered into a fake complete list; agents (primary) → fatal error; work_items/routines/objectives → per-section UNAVAILABLE; projects/businesses → blocks creation + unavailable list; businessDetail validates child collections (agents/objectives/routines/board) before render.
